title.en: Post-Raid Campaign Cannot Be Completed - Blizzard Investigating
title.es: No se puede completar la campaña posterior al ataque: Blizzard está investigando

summary.en: Post-Raid Campaign Cannot Be Completed - Blizzard Investigating...
summary.es: No se puede completar la campaña posterior al ataque: Blizzard está investigando...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced that they are investigating an issue where the Post-Raid campaign cannot be completed.

After defeating Kith'ix, players are shown two cinematics: one right after Kith'ix dies, and the other during the post-raid campaign. After seeing both of these, the next quest What the World Sees is bugged and cannot be completed right now.
Blizzard
View Original
Thanks for the reports! We’re looking into the issues where the quests “Belly of the Beast” and “What the World Sees” cannot be completed.

contentHtml:
World of Warcraft: Forever appears to be having a stress test on October 19th!

If you check your Battle.net launcher, you may notice a new game mode on World of Warcraft: WoW: Forever - Stress Test. Selecting this option will allow you to download the client and indicates that this will become available on October 19th.

title.es: Blizzard lanza problemas conocidos para el parche 12.1.5

summary.en: Blizzard Releases Known Issues for Patch 12.1.5...
summary.es: Blizzard libera problemas conocidos para el parche 12.1.5...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has released a list of known issues for the launch of Patch 12.1.5, and will likely update the list further as more is worked on over the next few days.

Thankfully, the list is very short this time around - what players will likely see most frequently is the War Campaign breadcrumbs, but as to current content, things seem fairly bug-free (we're not counting the Aqir invasions; those are obviously bug-themed).
Blizzard
View Original
The Midnight: 12.1.5 content update is now live. Please read on for a list of known issues that we’re working on and further information about this update.

12.1.5 KNOWN ISSUES

Housing

  • The Large Karabor Fountain decor unintentionally has collision enabled within the fountain’s water.
  • The Anima-Powered Kyrian Oven decor is missing collision.

Quests

  • The Battle for Azeroth War Campaign breadcrumb quests may pop-up for characters after their Legion and Battle for Azeroth reputations have been converted and shared across the warband.
For those just returning or who otherwise need to be caught up we have guides for both new and returning players.
New Player’s Guide
  • New Player Help and Guides forum
Returning Player’s Guide
  • Returning Player Help and Discussion forum
As with any update, it is important to make sure that if you use addons that they have been updated.

contentHtml:
With the arrival of Patch 12.1.5, Wowhead has updated guides for new class changes, activities, and raids to help set players up for success!

Kith'ix Raid

The Midnight story continues in Patch 12.1.5 with the one-boss Kith'ix raid and a new campaign to see what comes next in The Worldsoul Saga. The raid supports 10 to 30 players on Normal and Heroic and is Flexible Mythic for 15 to 25 players. There are some unique cantrip items from this boss, so make sure to check it out and get some awesome loot.

Kith’ix Raid


 

Labyrinth of Kindo'jan

The Labyrinth of Kindo'jan launches with 9 sprawling chambers, ending in a brand new Nemesis Boss fight.

Labyrinth of Kindo'jan


 

Aqir Invasions

With the threat of Kith'ix, the Aqir have started to surface and invade! Take on the Aqir Invasions in Patch 12.1.5 every hour.

Aqir Invasions


 

Mounts

Looking to collect more mounts? There are three new mounts in Patch 12.1.5, including the brand new Fungalstrider mount, which includes customizable vendors.

Patch 12.1.5 Mounts


 

Ascendant Venomstones

The quest for Ascendant Venomstones starts today, but they won't become available until next week. Learn everything you need to know about them in our guide.

Ascendant Venomstones


 

Class Guides

Many classes have some changes in Patch 12.1.5, with some major updates to Devourer DH and Marksmanship Hunter. With all the new changes, our class writers have been hard at work updating our class guides. Whether you're rolling a new character or looking for a refresher, check out our updated class guides!
